metrics.label: HaluMem recall
metrics.definition: Mean HaluMem extraction score across gold memory points using the 0, 0.5, 1 rubric.

metrics.label: HaluMem weighted recall
metrics.definition: Importance-weighted HaluMem extraction score across gold memory points.

metrics.label: Target precision
metrics.definition: Share of extracted claims with at least one positive gold memory match.

metrics.label: HaluMem F1
metrics.definition: Harmonic mean of target precision and unweighted HaluMem recall.

metrics.label: Faithfulness rate
metrics.definition: Share of extracted claims grounded by at least one positive gold match.

metrics.label: Hallucination rate
metrics.definition: Share of extracted claims with no positive gold memory match.

metrics.label: Overreach rate
metrics.definition: Share of extracted claims that add unsupported specificity, causal claims, or role attribution beyond the source turns.

metrics.label: Temporal correctness
metrics.definition: Share of positive matched claims whose temporal anchoring is correct when the matched gold memory requires time.

metrics.label: Redundancy rate
metrics.definition: Share of extracted claims that repeat a prior extracted claim under the same deduplication key.
